page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc9i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 24.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.4 GHz make this instance suitable for compute-intensive workloads that require consistent CPU performance without virtualization overhead. Due to its 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, it is optimized for raw processing power rather than memory-heavy operations. This hardware profile is appropriate for workloads such as web serving, batch processing, and application servers that do not require local SSD storage or GPU acceleration.
